title: Normalized Cartan--Eilenberg total-cohomology comparison
statement: Let $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$, $G:\mathcal B\to\mathcal C$ be left exact additive functors between Grothendieck abelian categories with derived categories, satisfying injective acyclicity [def-sp-composite-acyclicity]. There exist $h_P^n:H^n(\operatorname{Tot}G(I_P))\cong R^n(GF)(P.X)$ for all presentations [def-sp-cartan-eilenberg-presentation] and $n\ge0$, natural for presentation comparisons. The augmentation with the canonical extension and $(n,0)$-summand components induces, after composition with $h_P^n$, the canonical extended-injective-resolution homology computation followed by $(P.J.\mathrm{isoRightDerivedObj}(GF,n))^{-1}$.

proof.text: Take the natural augmentation quasi-isomorphism of lem-sp-ce-acyclic-augmentation. For each n invert its homology isomorphism, then compose with extendHomologyIso and the inverse of the canonical injective-resolution derived computation. Cancellation proves the normalization equation.
Apply homology to the augmentation naturality square and cancel the augmentation homology map. Naturality of extendHomologyIso and isoRightDerivedObj_inv_naturality give the comparison equation.
